description: This file defines the main application shell component for a note-taking frontend, including sub-components for authentication panels, sidebar, notes list, editor, and overall routing logic. It manages state for notes, tags, user authentication, and routing, and contains functions for CRUD operations with an API.

methods.name: useHotkey
methods.description: Custom hook to handle global hotkey events, specifically handling Ctrl+K or Cmd+K to focus search input.

methods.name: useDebouncedCallback
methods.description: Hook that creates a debounced version of a callback function, used to delay save operations.

methods.name: formatUpdatedAt
methods.description: Formats an optional ISO date string into a locale string, or returns empty string if invalid.

methods.name: retroTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of a note or defaults to 'Untitled' if missing or whitespace.
